integrity: A self-contained uniform concentration proof supports the asymptotic claim. Standalone exhaustive verification through chain size ten and seeded finite diagnostics are corroboration, not an infinite proof. Existing rank/fixed-point counting theorems are acknowledged as prior work.
scientific_limitations: Convergence in probability only, with no second-order or finite-size error rate. The conditional assertion assumes the complement of the prescribed fixed interval tends to infinity. This applies to total order-preserving contractions, not arbitrary monotone maps or order-reversing contractions. Novelty relative to unlocated general iteration theorems remains a bibliographic risk.
title: Logarithmic power stabilization for finite-chain order-preserving contractions
